backend: Real local Wrangler Worker and D1
storage_boundary: Account-scoped normal UI; not isolation from a person controlling this browser or OS

checks.test: Administrator retains the legacy identity database and a verified non-exportable key pair
A changed account cookie forces the already-open app to reload before using the new account
The fresh member sees neither the administrator identity nor administrator contacts
The member creates a different verified non-exportable identity and a separate contact
Returning to the administrator restores the original identity and only its original contact
The real authenticated application and account link fit a 320px mobile viewport
